domain: A3-S1: Python decorator/hook patterns for verdict auto-emit
oneLineSummary: (c) atexit + (d) sys.excepthook 3-layer (atexit + excepthook + SIGTERM handler) via sitecustomize.py = ZERO-source-mod retrofit for 29 untouched scripts. Idempotent merge preserves 18 existing outputs.
rootCause: Decorator (a) and contextmanager (b) require per-script body edits -- defeats zero-mod constraint. atexit fires on normal exit + sys.exit(N); excepthook captures unhandled exceptions; signal.SIGTERM covers timeout. os._exit() and SIGKILL skip -- audit confirms no os._exit in ICE corpus.
recommendation: Drop-in /Users/lagyeongjun/CD/SYMPOSIUM/METAHUMOTONIC/ICE_ORCA_DRAGON/_verdict_auto_emit.py (~80 LOC): merges into existing _results.json via setdefault() (never overwrites human verdict), structural verdict='COMPLETED'|'ERROR' only -- NEVER auto-set CONFIRMED to avoid MT_RubberStampVerdict. Pair with subprocess wrapper for CI/batch. Reject (a)/(b) for retrofit.
caveats: auto-setting verdict='CONFIRMED' on returncode==0 = MT_RubberStampVerdict violation. Heavy work in atexit fails (subsystems torn down). sitecustomize global install must use opt-in env var SYMPOSIUM_VERDICT_AUTO_EMIT=1.
